name: Tool4seller
description:
Tool4seller connects Claude to your authorized Amazon seller data through a secure, read-only connector.

Ask Claude to analyze sales and profit performance, review advertising campaigns and targeting metrics, monitor inventory and inventory alerts, inspect sales traffic, track product reviews, and check FBA inbound shipments across your connected Amazon stores.

The connector supports store-level and product-level reporting, multi-store comparisons, advertising performance analysis, and advanced targeting searches using metrics such as clicks, orders, ACoS, CTR, and conversion rate.

Access is authorized through OAuth and limited to the stores and permissions available in your Tool4seller account. The connector is read-only: it does not modify Amazon listings, inventory, orders, campaigns, bids, or budgets.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Tool4seller to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Tool4seller to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://das-server.tool4seller.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Tool4seller MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tool4seller lists 21 MCP tools, including diagnose_ad_efficiency, diagnose_profit_anomaly, diagnose_sales_change, discover_capabilities, get_current_user, inventory_risk_review, list_inbound_shipment_items, list_inbound_shipments, list_stores, query_advertising, query_advertising_campaigns, and query_advertising_purchased_products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Tool4seller?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Tool4seller in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Tool4seller requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Tool4seller is developed by Tapcash Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
